requirementVerdicts.honestBoundedExtractionBy120WithoutFullC: partial pass: the research phase actually invokes a command by 120 seconds and does not require the adjudicated config
requirementVerdicts.rejectsEmptyMarkers: partial fail: empty lists are rejected, but one shallow relPath-only object per ID passes and is the test fixture itself
requirementVerdicts.viability90: partial pass: deadline, selection IDs, union collision, result count and positive hit checks exist; count rows are not bound to selected IDs or terms
requirementVerdicts.config240: partial fail: mtime deadline and entry-ID list are checked, but a placeholder config containing only entries[{id}] passes the checkpoint test
requirementVerdicts.constructor250: fail: command is invoked by deadline, but no command-audit, authorized engine SHA, stable environment wrapper, exact argv hash, or config SHA binding is required before execution
requirementVerdicts.firstProduct270: fail: any post-receipt file, including {}, passes; product Identity.Id, configured output path, config binding, and compiler report are not checked
requirementVerdicts.construction330: fail: an empty manifest plus arbitrary hardPass preclosure/closure passes; selected IDs, product hashes, manifest/closure bindings, and real preclosure scope are not verified
requirementVerdicts.receiptFirst: partial fail: cohort artifacts are checked only against the numeric startedEpoch; timegate creation order and immutable checkpoint receipts are not enforced
requirementVerdicts.commandAudit: fail: research checks only the last argv and file mtime; command epochs are not checked against startedEpoch, and constructor has no command audit at all

hardDefects.finding: The supposed real-extraction gate accepts a candidate object containing only relPath. It does not require fromLb, complete bounded context/window, workId, tier/source authority, or any nonempty extracted text.
hardDefects.impact: A fabricated shallow marker satisfies the 120-second checkpoint without paying real bounded extraction.

hardDefects.finding: Only commands[-1].argv is compared. No command epoch is required or checked, and earlier audited commands are ignored.
hardDefects.impact: Pre-receipt activity can be represented inside a post-receipt audit file.

hardDefects.finding: The config gate checks only entries[].id. The test explicitly passes a two-row ID-only placeholder. The constructor command has no audit or authorized engine/wrapper/SHA binding.
hardDefects.impact: The repair does not prove an adjudicated config exists by 240 or that the authorized generic engine is what runs by 250.

hardDefects.finding: The checkpoint hashes a file but never parses it or checks its Identity.Id against --id. The current test uses an empty JSON object and expects only the late deadline to fail.
hardDefects.impact: A fake or unrelated file can satisfy the first-product milestone.

hardDefects.finding: The current passing test uses an empty manifest. Preclosure and closure need only hardPass=true; no selected scope, product hashes, or cross-artifact bindings are checked.
hardDefects.impact: The 330-second closure can be green without demonstrating construction.

hardDefects.finding: The numeric startedEpoch is trusted without verifying that the timegate itself is the earliest artifact. Viability, constructor, product, and construction receipts may overwrite existing paths.
hardDefects.impact: Receipt-zero ordering and immutable checkpoint history are not fail-closed.

requiredCorrections: Require every extraction candidate to contain a nonempty bounded complete-case/context payload plus exact relPath, fromLb, workId, tier, and matched term/span; require the research skeleton to bind those candidate hashes rather than repeat shallow objects.
Validate every command-audit epoch is at or after startedEpoch and bind the exact invoked argv; require the same audit discipline for constructor invocation.
At config240 validate the exact generic config schema, deterministic IDs, sourceDossier/evidenceDraft payload presence, selection/research equality, allowed-root containment, and config SHA.
At constructor250 require the independently authorized generic-engine SHA and stable dictionary_python_env.py wrapper SHA, exact argv, and audit binding.
At first270 parse the canonical product, require Identity.Id/SourceTerm/config equality, governed output path, and successful compiler report.
At construction330 require exact selected IDs and product hashes across manifest, preclosure and closure, with current hardPass bindings rather than boolean-only files.
Make every phase receipt immutable and prove timegate artifact-zero ordering rather than trusting a caller-supplied epoch.

Add negative tests for shallow candidates, pre-receipt command epochs, ID-only config, unauthorized constructor/wrapper, empty/wrong-ID products, empty manifests, mismatched closure hashes, late config240/constructor250/construction330, and receipt overwrite.
